sentence: This project studies how long non-coding RNAs and viral integration affect cancer progression and gene regulation in head and neck cancers.
This project tries to find out how matrix stiffness and viscoelasticity control cell proliferation in 3D microenvironments.
This project builds a delivery vehicle for Cas9 that edits large volumes of brain tissue, and tests it in mouse models of fragile X syndrome.
This project builds a technology that sequences and profiles cancer-related proteins and general proteomes, identifying mutations and post-translational modifications.
This project runs a clinical trial of an antisense inhibitor in patients with relapsed myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia, and studies therapy resistance.
This project builds an assay that uses phage-amplified mass spectrometry to identify bacteria and test antibiotic susceptibility directly in urine.
This project uses the transparent embryos of Ciona to find out which genes control cell behaviors during neural development and what happens without them.
This project uses machine learning and experiments to predict and test whether plastic additives disrupt endocrine function.
This project improves a fluorescent screening assay to find botanical small molecule blockers of a voltage-gated proton channel that may relieve neuropathic pain.
This project tries to understand how gait-related brain activity changes in animal models of Parkinson's disease.
This project studies the molecules that control germ cell differentiation and how germ cells protect the integrity of their genomes.
This project builds partnerships and research infrastructure for cancer research in Pacific Island populations.
This project studies the structure and function of transient receptor potential channels using biophysical and biochemical techniques.
This project builds a perfused organ panel as a test system for hazards of environmental toxicants such as organophosphate and carbamate pesticides.
This project uses electronic health records to study how stigma affects cancer care and survivorship care for people living with HIV and cancer.
This project tries to find out how changes in mitochondria affect the function of different types of T cells.
This project studies how a potassium ion channel controls cytokine production and bone mass in mice, and tests whether deleting it prevents osteoporosis.
This project sets up an AI server to analyze genomics, imaging and clinical records and build predictive models for treatment response.
This project makes genetically-modified mouse models for diabetes research, using CRISPR and other methods.
